Question B-002-005-009.

Why the correct answer is right: Full break-in CW lets the operator hear incoming signals between transmitted dots and dashes.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "Automatic keyers are used instead of hand keys": Using an automatic keyer does not by itself provide receiver recovery between code elements.
- sourceIndex 2: "An operator must activate a manual send/receive switch before and after every transmission": Manual send/receive switching is the opposite of full break-in convenience.
- sourceIndex 3: "Stations wishing to break in must send the Morse code signal \"BK\"": Sending BK is an interruption signal, not the definition of QSK operation.
